visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins inside a martial arts gym with two men standing on gray padded mats. Person A is wearing a black t-shirt and white athletic shorts, while Person B (the coach) wears a patterned blue/black shirt and red Muay Thai shorts. Both are equipped with boxing gloves, preparing to engage in a sparring session. The background features windows, wall-mounted fans, and blue-and-black padded safety mats. (2) Person B initiates a series of rapid punches toward Person A, who attempts to block and dodge. A text overlay counts the hits, starting with "一拳". Person A's facial expression shows focus and effort as he absorbs the impact of the strikes. The lighting is bright and even, provided by overhead fluorescent panels. (3) The sequence accelerates as Person B continues the assault. Punches are numbered from "二拳" up to "十四拳" in white text overlays (skipping "八拳"). They move dynamically across the gym floor, with Person A being pushed backward by the coach's intensity. Various boxing equipment and gear bags are visible along the perimeter of the room. (4) After the numbered sequence, the sparring continues as they circle each other. Person A maintains a defensive stance while Person B looks for openings. The camera remains static at an eye-level perspective, providing a full-body view of both participants and the spacious, well-lit training environment.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy, upbeat electronic pop BGM begins with a driving synthesizer bassline and steady drum machine beat. A sharp impact sound (smack) is heard immediately as the first punch lands. (2) Consecutive rhythmic thud and smack sounds trigger in rapid succession, perfectly synchronized with the numbered punches on screen. The acoustic texture is dominated by these percussive transients over the constant music floor. (3) Occasional male vocal grunts and sharp exhalations ("Hu!") are heard between the musical beats, indicating high physical exertion and strain. The music volume remains high and consistent without fading. (4) The dense sequence of impact sounds continues until the numbering stops, after which the ambient gym noise becomes slightly more audible under the ongoing BGM as the intensity of movement shifts to a steady sparring pace.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To create a humorous comparison between the expectation of a 'boxing aerobics' class and the reality of a rigorous sparring session with a coach.
